subject: delta(client): WF read the mempool broadcast reply, the staked-node refusal and the bounded not-found lookup of node build e6af8f40 in storage-write recovery
note: Node build e6af8f40 answers a storage write taken into its mempool with a null response and exactly confirmationBlock, lastBlockNumber, published, hash and disposition "mempool" in extra. The classifier counts it as accepted only when hash is the hash that was sent; any other answer stays unknown and is never recovered. Both 61b8e75 replies keep their reading. A node that is not a staked validator answers 400 with extra { error: "NOT_A_VALIDATOR" } before the transaction reaches its mempool or the transaction topic; the classifier records it as refused-not-validator, a definite refusal that recovery never resends. getTxByHash for an unknown hash answers 404 with extra { reason: "not_found", checkedThroughBlock }. Recovery reads it as absence only with exactly those members and checkedThroughBlock at or past R+2 of the write's kept confirmation reference block R, the last block that can execute the write, and never without a kept R; a lookup_failed 500 is never absence. The scripted test world can now replace a node answer, and the new tests run the classifiers directly and through the native transport.
